scripts.prepare:web: set -eu; rm -rf www; mkdir -p www; for file in *.html *.css *.js *.webmanifest *.png *.jpg *.jpeg *.svg *.ico *.webp; do [ -f "$file" ] && cp "$file" www/ || true; done; for d in assets images icons; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then rsync -a "$d/" "www/$d/"; fi; done
scripts.build:android: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
